facts.raw_span: A 46-year-old Japanese woman
history of epilepsy
redness and swelling of the right breast
erythema and swelling in the lower right breast
Ultrasound revealed a 54 × 41 × 31 mm low-echo mass with partially unclear margins in the outer right breast
invasive ductal carcinoma (no special type), high grade, ER+, PgR–, HER2 3+, Ki67 70%
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in the right axilla, anterior mediastinum, left pleura, and liver
consistent with cT4dN3M1 stage IV breast cancer
lesions nearly disappeared
clinical complete response maintained for 23 months
persistent headache
a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe

concepts.why: The patient's biopsy showed invasive ductal carcinoma, and whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake consistent with stage IV breast cancer.
The patient developed a persistent headache, and CT and MRI of the head revealed a mass lesion in the right temporal lobe, consistent with a brain metastasis from the breast cancer.
The patient has a history of epilepsy, which is a neurological disorder.
The patient developed a persistent headache and a mass lesion in the right temporal lobe, which may indicate a recurrence of the breast cancer.
The patient received trastuzumab and developed a brain metastasis, which may indicate resistance to trastuzumab.
The patient developed a persistent headache and a mass lesion in the right temporal lobe after receiving chemotherapy, which may be related to the cancer treatment.
The patient's whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake consistent with stage IV breast cancer.

aliases: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-positive breast cancer
concepts.why: The patient's biopsy showed HER2-positive breast cancer.
